finalText:
The bug was in how the pagination calculated the starting index. Pages are 1-indexed in the interface, but JavaScript arrays are 0-indexed, so the code needed to subtract 1 from the page number.

Changed line 7 from:
```javascript
const start = page * perPage;
```

to:
```javascript
const start = (page - 1) * perPage;
```

All 5 tests pass now.
